goal: Is ke baad aap char array mein text store kar sakte hain, null character samjha sakte hain, cin aur cin.getline se naam read kar sakte hain, uski length nikaal sakte hain, aur strlen, strcpy, strcmp aur strcat use kar sakte hain.
warmup: Cricket scoreboard par player ka naam chhote chhote boxes ki row mein dikhaya jata hai, har box mein ek letter. Jab naam board se chhota hota hai to baaki boxes khaali reh jate hain. Character array bhi aise hi kaam karta hai: har box mein ek letter. Computer khaali boxes ko dekh nahi sakta, is liye hum aakhri letter ke bilkul baad ek khaas nishaan laga dete hain jis ka matlab hai 'naam yahan khatam hota hai'. Woh nishaan null character hai.
definition: Character array char ka array hota hai jo text store karta hai. Is style ka har text (C-string) null character par khatam hota hai, jo '\0' likha jata hai aur jis ka ASCII code 0 hai. Null character print nahi hota. Yeh cout aur string functions ko batata hai ke text kahan rukta hai. Isi wajah se n letters store karne wale array mein kam az kam n + 1 boxes hone chahiye.
howItWorks: Banayein: char name[6] = "Ahmad"; A, h, m, a, d aur phir '\0' store karta hai (5 letters + 1 = 6 boxes). Agar aap char name[] = "Ahmad"; likhein to compiler size khud ginn leta hai. Agar array text se bara ho, maslan char city[20] = "Lahore";, to baaki boxes '\0' se bhar jate hain. Display: cout << name; '\0' tak saare letters print karta hai. Yeh seedha sirf char arrays par kaam karta hai, int arrays par nahi. Read: cin >> name; EK word read karta hai aur pehle space par ruk jata hai. cin.getline(name, 30); space samet poori line read karta hai, aur ziyada se ziyada 29 characters ke baad ruk jata hai, taake aakhri box '\0' ke liye bacha rahe. Length haath se: len = 0 se shuru karein aur while (name[len] != '\0') len++; likhein. <cstring> ke library functions: strlen(s) length deta hai, strcpy(dest, src) copy karta hai, strcat(dest, src) src ko dest ke end mein jod deta hai, aur strcmp(a, b) 0 return karta hai agar dono text barabar hon. Aap = se copy ya == se compare nahi kar sakte, kyun ke array ka naam aam variable nahi hota. Har letter asal mein ek number hai: 'A' 65 hai, 'a' 97 hai aur '\0' 0 hai. Hello ke codes dekhne ke liye Visualize tab kholein, jahan aakhir mein 0 nazar aayega.
